cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your picnic rota is useful. Mine has committee approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine got everyone to bring sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Mine establishes who was entitled to request those sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then approve mine. We've already started eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll attach it as an appendix to mine, so lunch has a legitimate basis.

mechanism: A treats its pupil effective picnic rota as a promising draft that must sit beneath A formally approved method to count as legitimate.
confusable: Not a contest about who brings better food: A ranks authorization above effectiveness and absorbs the pupil solution as subordinate paperwork.
comparison: Practical picnic success subordinated to paperwork versus founder instruction treated as narrower than constitutional custom.
seedUse: D187 picnic rota/sandwiches/committee/appendix; S05 trained rota headings.
